text.en: 1. These Regulations are the District Cooling (Exemption from Section 7(3) and (5)) Regulations 2008.

2.—(1) Section 7(3) and (5) of the Act does not apply to any residential premises within any service area.
(2) In this regulation, “residential premises” means any premises or part of any premises which is used or permitted to be used for human habitation, pursuant to the Planning Act 1998 or any other written law, but does not include —
(a)any commercial property within the meaning of section 2 of the Sale of Commercial Properties Act 1979;
(b)any hotel registered under the Hotels Act 1954; and
(c)any premises which is approved for use as a serviced apartment under the Planning Act 1998.
